validityLabels: invalid-gap VALID regions stop at x=40 and resume at x=80; transitions are deliberately unlabeled; every cell intersecting a VALID label is checked against output support

hashing.recipeHash: SHA-256 over rendererRevision, case id, generator/geometry/source group ids, split, recipe id, seed, contrast, side, variant, equation, phase, source pitch, oversampling, reversal, and capabilities
hashing.catalogHash: SHA-256 over rendererRevision and sorted recipe hashes
hashing.holdoutInventory: case id, split, and recipeHash only

splitPolicy.holdoutMaterialization: requires-validated-frozen-artifact-receipt; hash syntax alone is refused; no receipt can be minted before Task4

splitGeometry.TRAIN: 0m offset plus 0.8*sin(2*pi*x/120); smooth sinusoidal geometry family
splitGeometry.SELECT: +2.5m offset plus 0.8*triangle(x/80), triangle(u)=4*abs(frac(u)-0.5)-1; piecewise triangular geometry family
splitGeometry.REGRESSION: fixed source geometry; never used for fitting

phaseSemantics: phase offsets the native sampling-grid origin by phase times native pitch; output pixels reuse the same native observations through production strict bilinear capture; metric geometry remains fixed

contrasts.right: same transverse amplitude and shape; multiply by sum exp(-0.5*((x-{24,60,96})/3)^2)

contrasts.labels: equal integrated scalar evidence budget; distinct spread and localization

contrasts.left: 0.02 + crossing/noisy traces at 26, 30+4*sin(2*pi*x/48), 34; changing valleys and sparse impulses
contrasts.right: 0.02 + persistent traces at 26 and 34 with a stable valley
contrasts.labels: AMBIGUOUS carries the two outer acceptable branches; no midpoint branch

contrasts.right: identical physical 12m apex observed with a half-native-pixel phase shift; no artificial second staircase geometry
contrasts.labels: same known physical apex across native phase and resampling aliases

regressionCases.invalid-gap: invalid support where 48m<=x<=72m; invalid is not zero evidence
regressionCases.censored-edge: band center y=5.4m lies 0.4m inside the y=5m decision edge; actual factory censoring is asserted

contrasts.labels: NO_STRUCTURE vs UNKNOWN; VALID, INVALID, and CENSORED remain distinct; regression only
same physical geometry and amplitude across equivalent sampling

contrasts.left: synthetic RGB proxy encoded blue and mapped with RenderedHeatmapSampler.colorIntensity(..., blue); synthetic native pitch is explicit
contrasts.right: same synthetic blue RGB proxy and direct rendered luminance 0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B; rendered pitch only
contrasts.labels: synthetic RGB proxy contrasts semantic vs rendered scalar lineage; real rendered-source capability is unavailable until producer fixtures exist

labelTypes.position: one or more explicit acceptable metric curves; ambiguous cases do not synthesize a center

evidenceContract.transform: RasterMetricTransform.metricGrid with physical metres per raster pixel
evidenceContract.resampling: direct scalar grid with explicit validity mask
